rules.title: Rent reduction for deterioration of services, care or maintenance
rules.requirement: When a tenant applies for a rent reduction because services, care or maintenance have deteriorated, the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board values the deteriorated services from no earlier than one year before the application and reduces the rent by that amount. If the problems persist, the Board may also reduce future rent until the landlord shows the services are corrected.
rules.key_value: Lookback up to 1 year before application; conditions must exist at filing or within 60 days before
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the Hoboken Rent Control Ordinance (City Code Chapter 155) where the tenant applies for a rent reduction for deteriorated services.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies on a tenant application showing deteriorated services; general rent control coverage criteria of Chapter 155 not stated in this document.

rules.penalty: Rent reduction ordered by the Board
rules.citation: Hoboken Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board Regulation 18:54(H)-01 (Regulations to Hoboken City Code Ch. 155)
rules.quoted_span: If the deteriorated services continue to exist at the time of the Board's determination, the Board may, in addition to the above, set an amount future rental payments are to be reduced until the landlord demonstrates to the Rent Regulation Officer that the deteriorated services have been corrected.
rules.conflict_note: Adoption/effective date not stated in this document; regulation implements Hoboken Rent Control Ordinance Chapter 155.

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol designation for units rented to multiple tenants
rules.requirement: A landlord renting a unit to multiple tenants may designate an original tenant group so that a vacancy for decontrol purposes occurs only when the last original tenant leaves. The signed designation must be filed with the Rent Control Office within 30 days of the start of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: File designation within 30 days of commencement of tenancy
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled apartment units in Hoboken rented to multiple tenants where the landlord seeks vacancy decontrol under Article VII of the Rent Control Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Pre-existing written agreements containing the same information are given equal effect if submitted upon a request for vacancy decontrol.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when a unit is rented to multiple tenants and the landlord seeks vacancy decontrol.

rules.citation: Hoboken Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board Regulation #3 (Vacancy Decontrol as to Multiple Tenants) (Regulations to Hoboken City Code Ch. 155)
rules.quoted_span: The designation under this regulation shall be signed by the landlord and the original tenants and a copy thereof shall be filed with the Rent Control Office within 30 days of the commencement of the tenancy.
rules.conflict_note: Date 2/12/2025 appears as the date listed for the regulation as amended by the Board; it may reflect amendment rather than original adoption.

rules.title: Filing deadlines for vacancy decontrol certificates
rules.requirement: A landlord may file a vacancy decontrol certificate under Section 155-33 only for years it legally owned the dwelling, within one year of the vacancy or of first re-renting, with the dwelling registered under Section 155-31, and before a legal rent calculation is requested. Certificates for years the landlord did not own the dwelling are rejected.
rules.key_value: Within 1 year of vacancy or first re-rental
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of dwellings subject to Hoboken Rent Control Ordinance Chapter 155 seeking vacancy decontrol.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies when a landlord files a vacancy decontrol certificate.

rules.penalty: Untimely certificates rejected and not usable in legal rent determinations
rules.citation: Hoboken Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board Regulation 18:66 (Regulations to Hoboken City Code Ch. 155)
rules.quoted_span: A Landlord may not file a Certificate pursuant to Section 155-33 for any year where the Landlord was not the legal owner of the dwelling.

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol certificates filed after legal rent calculation request
rules.requirement: A vacancy decontrol certificate filed after a tenant requests a legal rent calculation cannot be used in calculating the legal rent. After that tenant leaves, the landlord may file a certificate for that departure within six years.
rules.key_value: Certificate after tenant vacates must be filed within 6 years
rules.coverage_conditions: Dwellings subject to Hoboken Rent Control Ordinance Chapter 155 where vacancy decontrol is claimed.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies when a landlord files a vacancy decontrol certificate after a tenant's legal rent calculation request.

rules.penalty: Certificate deemed untimely and unusable for legal rent calculation
rules.citation: Hoboken Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board Regulation 18:67 (Regulations to Hoboken City Code Ch. 155)
rules.quoted_span: A vacancy decontrol certificate filed by a landlord after a tenant requests a legal rent calculation may not be utilized for the purposes of conducting a future rent calculation.
rules.conflict_note: Document shows Board approval 3/26/08 and submission to City Clerk 4/3/08; effective date not separately stated.
